ivy-ops: Heads-up: SA-gpu pool failing to join after last night's firewall tightening + KMS pruning. 4/10 nodes healthy.

tara-sre: Can you share the node error?

ivy-ops: Log: `2026-05-12T04:12:01Z ERROR nodejoin: auth verify failed: kms:DecryptDenied; audit-shipper PUT -> 403`

marco-sec: We removed an old keystore grant and tightened the firewall to explicit service CIDRs. Looks like the audit-shipper's signer IPs and a long-lived grant were both affected. Oops.

deploy-bot: Canary run sa-priv-rot: 3/8 nodes failed join; roll paused.

ops-bot: Alert: sa-gpu-pool down 60% -> fallback to us-east, cost delta projected +$2.4k/day.

tara-sre: Mitigation options: 1) add signer CIDR to firewall allowlist 2) recreate grant for shipper role 3) rollback firewall. Least blasty?

marco-sec: Adding CIDR is quickest and low-risk. I'll add `10.200.5.0/24` for 1h. Also recreate grant in parallel.

marco-sec: Command: `aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-sa --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.200.5.0/24`

marco-sec: Created. Recreating KMS grant now: `aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/sa-keystore --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/audit-shipper --operations Encrypt Decrypt`

audit-bot: shipper: PUT /sa/logs/nodejoin 200 (ok)

deploy-bot: Canary re-run: 8/8 nodes joined within 70s.

ops-bot: Pool recovered. Cost projection normalized. :white_check_mark:

ivy-ops: Follow-ups: - add signer CIDR check to firewall rollout preflight - include direct-grant fallback in key rotation playbook - add post-rotate smoke that exercises audit-shipper PUT from signer subnet.

marco-sec: Will add runbook lines and schedule a TTL revert test in canary.

tara-sre: I'll pace job restarts to avoid a thundering herd. Closing thread.
